name: fill_mem_eff_dropout_mask_
description: Representative ATen schema: aten::_fill_mem_eff_dropout_mask_(Tensor(a!) self, float dropout_p, int seed, int offset) -> Tensor(a!). Fills a contiguous four-dimensional float32 attention mask in place from the Philox stream and returns self. Tests cover representative shapes, seeds and offsets, value range, ignored dropout_p, exact object and storage identity, pointer/stride/storage-offset preservation, and invalid rank, dtype, and layout errors.
